title: Operatively Treated Open Pilon Fractures
brief_summary: A chart review will be performed to extrapolate information including sex, height, weight, date/time admitted to HMC, injury data, comorbidities, fracture pattern, antibiotic usage, surgical history, wound history, fracture healing, and length of time to return to work. Dr.'s Goodspeed and Reid will conduct a radiographic review independently for each subject, classifying all fractures according to the Orthopaedic Trauma Association classification guide. If a discrepancy in classification is found, then both will discuss together and come to a consensus.
study_population: Adult (18 years and older) patients treated with definitive open reduction and fixation of open pilon fractures between 2000 - 2007 at Hershey Medical Center.
